text:
If you’ve got outdoor plans, Thursday is the day to use, though it’ll be breezy and more cloud-covered than sunny. We’ll warm to around 71, with a south wind gusting near 24 mph. The forecast spread runs from the upper 60s to low 70s, and Google’s forecast is on the warmer side, so I’d bet on a mild afternoon with a few breaks of sun. On the lake, south winds build to 20 to 25 knots with 1 to 3 foot waves, so this isn’t a casual paddling day.

Clouds thicken tonight, with showers likely after 10 and a mild low around 63. Friday is the soggy turn, with showers, a high near 66, and roughly a quarter to half inch of rain possible. The payoff is Saturday, when sharper, drier air brings back sunshine and a cooler high around 60. Take advantage of today for errands or a walk, but be off the broad lake before the stronger south wind settles in.
